---
title: Reference
description: >
  Look up Panache's commands, configuration options, lint rules, and external
  formatter and linter presets.
---

Use these pages to look up specific commands, settings, and rules. For setup and
everyday workflows, start with the [Guide](../guide/index.qmd).

- [CLI Reference](cli.qmd): commands, arguments, and flags.
- [Configuration Reference](configuration.qmd): available settings, defaults,
  discovery, and precedence.
- [Lint Rules](linter-rules.qmd): rule IDs, examples, severity, fixes, and
  configuration requirements.
- [External Formatter Presets](formatter-presets.qmd): supported languages and
  the formatter commands Panache invokes.
- [External Linter Presets](linter-presets.qmd): supported languages and the
  linter commands Panache invokes.
